graph.name: Fidelity Investments - Enterprise Kubernetes on AWS EKS
graph.notes: Fidelity Investments built custom abstractions around AWS EKS (Fed EKS) including EKS Manager, Namespace Bootstrapper, and EKS Connect to govern security, identity, and automated cluster provisioning at scale.

nodes.name: EKS Manager
nodes.notes: Custom tool wrapping CloudFormation and GitOps framework for EKS cluster provisioning, infrastructure management, and daemonset governance.

nodes.name: EKS
nodes.notes: Amazon EKS cluster hosting Fidelity containerized application workloads across isolated namespaces.

nodes.name: Bootstrapper
nodes.notes: Namespace Bootstrapper CRD extending namespace creation, security integration, secrets management (Vault), and ALB Ingress setup.

nodes.name: EKS Connect
nodes.notes: Go-based wrapper around kubectl ensuring authentication, user validation, and target namespace determination.

nodes.name: RBAC
nodes.notes: Kubernetes Role-Based Access Control enforcing fine-grained user and group permissions within namespaces.

nodes.name: IAM
nodes.notes: AWS IAM service bridging Kubernetes RBAC permissions with AWS identity.

nodes.name: AD
nodes.notes: Enterprise Active Directory backend handling federated identity and user authentication.

edges.notes: EKS Manager provisions EKS cluster and manages compute, network, storage, and daemonset resources.
Kubernetes RBAC connects to AWS IAM for role mapping.
AWS IAM returns authorization details to Kubernetes RBAC.
AWS IAM integrates with Active Directory for enterprise user authentication.
Active Directory authenticates identity to AWS IAM.
